subject: SOC 2 Type II & trust portal access - Acme Health next steps
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II / trust portal access

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. A couple of quick follow-ups from the security and procurement teams here at Acme Health:

- Can you share your SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a bridge letter if the report period doesn’t fully cover our window?
- We’ll need access to your trust portal so our security team can review evidence. Can you invite Lara (cc’d) to the portal?
- I’m also attaching our vendor security questionnaire — can someone on your side start the questionnaire or confirm who will be owning it?
- Separate question: does Redwood have any HIPAA / BA agreement guidance for PHI use cases?

Timeline: procurement would like the materials this week if possible.

Attached: ACME_Vendor_Q_Sheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Samir
Security Program Lead
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II / trust portal access

Hi Samir —

Great to connect today — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: I’ve attached our most recent SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2026-12-31). If you need a different date range or an auditor contact, let me know and I can provide additional details.

2) Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter that covers activity since the report period. I’m attaching a draft bridge letter (Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx). We typically finalize after a short internal sign-off (1-2 business days).

3) Trust portal access: Please send the full name and email of each person you want invited. I can create the invite and share a direct link. If Lara is who you want to start with, I’ll send her an invite now.

4) Vendor questionnaire: Happy to own the questionnaire from our side. I’ll have a member of the security team start populating answers and will flag any items that need input from your IT team.

5) HIPAA / BA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workflows under a customer BA arrangement. I’m looping in Neha (cc’d), who owns our DPA/BA process and can share the standard BA template and guidance on scoping.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx

Next steps: I’ll invite Lara to the trust portal today and Neha will follow up on BA/DPA steps. Expect a questionnaire response within 2 business days.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II / trust portal access

Thanks Marissa — that’s perfect. Please invite Lara (lara.chen@acme-health.com) and cc me on the invite.

A couple of additional asks from procurement:
- Can you confirm your typical SLA uptime and the target P99 latency for inference endpoints? We’ll need that as part of the procurement packet.
- For the BA, can Neha confirm the typical turnaround and whether Redwood signs customer-specific BAAs or uses an addendum?

I’ve re-attached the vendor questionnaire in case the team missed it earlier. If you could confirm who is owning the vendor Q and an ETA for the completed responses, that would be great.

Attached: ACME_Vendor_Q_Sheet.xlsx

Best,
Samir

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-health.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II / trust portal access

Hi Samir —

I’ve completed the items below:

- Portal invite: Lara has been invited to our trust portal. Direct access link: https://trust.redwoodinference.com/invite?token=acme-2027-04 (expires in 7 days). Please let me know if you need SSO or a different account type and I’ll route to our portal admins.

- Bridge letter: Attached is the updated bridge letter PDF (final pending one internal signature). We expect to provide the fully executed bridge letter by end of day tomorrow.

- Vendor questionnaire: Aditya (cc’d) is owning the questionnaire and will return a first-pass completed file by EOD tomorrow. Any technical clarifications he needs, he’ll reach out directly.

- HIPAA / BA: Neha (cc’d) — can you confirm the BA turnaround and whether we’ll share the standard BAA or draft a customer-specific BAA?

- SLA & performance: Our standard hosted SLA is 99.9% for uptime on Dedicated plans; P99 latency varies by model and region — for typical LLM generation models we target P99 sub-500ms on Dedicated in us-west. I can have a short performance summary exported for procurement if helpful.

Attachments: Redwood_Bridge_Letter_Draft.docx (updated PDF attached in portal invite email); Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf

Next: Aditya will send the completed questionnaire, Neha will follow up on BAA details, and I’ll send the finalized bridge letter. If you need anything faster, ping me directly.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
